applies_why: The judge text does not count any cited-in verse as an unanswered witness; it says the rows were answered and leaves the sign's sense open.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge text does not count a cited-in verse as an unanswered witness and instead treats the point as underdetermined after [CR2] answered the rows, it obeys K-G4.
